# Verify cancelling a restore leaves the workspace unchanged

## What & Why
The restore preview now delays replacement until confirmation, but the cancel path should be protected by a regression test so future changes cannot accidentally apply a backup when the user dismisses it.

## Done looks like
- A browser test imports a valid backup and confirms the dialog appears
- Cancelling the dialog leaves the current profile draft, answers, applications, and local storage unchanged
- Confirming a later restore still applies the complete validated backup
